campo.gt: Note below a rejected numeric field; {a} = lower limit, excluded.
campo.max: Note below a rejected numeric field; {b} = maximum value allowed.
campo.min: Note below a rejected numeric field; {a} = minimum value allowed.
campo.range: Note below a rejected numeric field; {a}, {b} = minimum and maximum values allowed.
ctl.zreset: Button in the "Range" box: goes back to the whole run (x and y).
ctl.zreset.title: Tooltip of the "Reset zoom" button when the chart is zoomed in.
ctl.zreset.off: Tooltip of the "Reset zoom" button when the chart is not zoomed in (inactive button).
ctl.zoomed: Hover text and screen reader text of the zoom bar; {range} = visible range (e.g. "RT 5.00-8.00 min").
ctl.map.norm.title: The quoted names are the three entries ctl.map.norm.abs / max / tic.
ctl.spec.lv: Accessible label of the spectrum title (MS with the level as a superscript); {n} = MS level.
ctl.spec.follow: The two quoted names are the buttons of the mode selector (nav.mode.sel, nav.mode.all).
ctl.ms2tr.opt: Entry of the MS2 transitions menu; {q1} = precursor m/z, {q3} = fragment m/z.
ctl.ms2tr.grp: Group heading in the MS2 fragments menu; {q1} = precursor m/z.
ctl.ms2tr.more: Disabled last entry of the MS2 fragments menu; {n} = fragments found but not listed.
ctl.prec.one: Entry of the precursors menu; {v} = precursor m/z.
ctl.files.aria: Accessible name of the shown-files button; {n} = visible files, {tot} = files in the tab.
ctl.files: Button in the header of a chart: files shown out of total files; {n} and {tot} = numbers.
dda.nav.group: Name of the ‹ i/N › group in the header of the MS2 panel of the DDA trio.
dda.nav.prev: Name and tooltip of the ‹ button of the MS2 panel; {i} = position of the MS2 shown among those of the same precursor, {n} = how many there are.
dda.nav.next: Name and tooltip of the › button of the MS2 panel; {i} = position of the MS2 shown among those of the same precursor, {n} = how many there are.
dda.nav.first: Short notice: ‹ on the first MS2 of the same precursor.
dda.nav.last: Short notice: › on the last MS2 of the same precursor.
dda.nav.only: Short notice: the precursor shown has a single MS2.
dda.peak.near: Short notice after clicking a Full Scan peak without its own MS2: the MS2 of the same ion nearest in time is opened; {d} = distance in minutes.
dda.tri.btn: Switch in the header of the chromatogram of the DDA trio: shows the triangles of the acquired MS2 spectra (name and tooltip: ctl.ms2tri, ctl.ms2tri.title).
dda.win.cut: Notice of the "N MS²" list and its button: beyond {n} parent Full Scans the precursor intensity is not read (it stays empty); next step.
srow.rt.win: Row "Retention times" of the MS² card: the scan window of the spectrum; {rt} = time or range with unit.
srow.rt.peak: Row "Retention times": limits of an integrated chromatographic peak the spectrum comes from; {a}, {b} = minutes.
srow.ce.one: Row "Collision energy" of the MS² card; {ce} = value in eV read from the file.
srow.ce.spread: Row "Collision energy" with stepped energies; {ce} = centre, {sd} = half width, in eV.
ctl.map.norm.fit: Option of the normalization menu of a DAD difference: the reference is multiplied by the least-squares factor that best matches the sample on the overlap.
ctl.map.subfactor.lab: Label of a number box in the DAD map options; the reference is multiplied by this number before it is subtracted. Empty = use the normalization menu.
ctl.map.subfactor.title: Tooltip of the scale factor box of the DAD difference.
ctl.map.subshift.lab: Label of a number box in the DAD map options: retention-time shift applied to the reference before subtracting.
ctl.map.subshift.title: Tooltip of the shift box of the DAD difference.
ctl.map.ms.mode: Label of a menu in the options of a DAD map: what its strips show.
ctl.map.ms.mode.title: Tooltip of that menu.
ctl.map.ms.ms: Menu entry: strips show the linked mass spectrometry.
ctl.map.ms.off.lab: Label of the DAD-to-MS time offset box; {input} is the number box.
ctl.map.ms.off.title: Tooltip of the offset box.
ctl.map.ms.trace.title: Tooltip of the menu choosing the MS trace under a DAD map.
ctl.map.ms.mz.title: Tooltip of the m/z box of the EIC.
ctl.map.ms.from.title: Tooltip of the menu choosing which file of a subtracted map supplies the MS.
ctl.map.ms.from.a: Menu entry: MS of file A.
ctl.map.ms.from.b: Menu entry: MS of the reference file B.
ctl.map.ms.est: Button that estimates the DAD-to-MS offset.
ctl.map.ms.est.title: Tooltip of that button.
ctl.map.ms.use: Button that applies the estimated offset.
ctl.map.ms.use.title: Tooltip of that button.
ctl.map.ms.src.default: Note: where the offset comes from (default).
ctl.map.ms.src.user: Note: where the offset comes from (typed by the user); {v} minutes.
ctl.map.ms.src.estimated: Note: where the offset comes from (estimate accepted by the user); {v} minutes.
ctl.map.ms.ev: Evidence of the offset estimate: {v} minutes, {n} peaks matched, {c} correlation, {file} file name.
ctl.map.ms.ev.none: Note when the estimate is not available.
ctl.map.ms.ev.busy: Note while the estimate is computed.
ctl.map.ms.used: Log line of an automatic choice the user accepted; {v} minutes, {n} peaks, {c} correlation.
ctl.map.ms.xic.log: Log line when the EIC strip of a DAD map asks for a new m/z; {mz} m/z, {tol} the half window in m/z, {lv} the MS level.
